title: metasurface-agent-pipeline: agent-driven inverse design of dielectric metasurfaces
description:
An agent-driven inverse-design pipeline for dielectric metasurfaces and metagratings. The user describes the target in plain language; an AI coding agent turns it into a configuration, runs GPU-accelerated, differentiable RCWA topology optimization (TORCWA) on a local machine or a SLURM cluster, analyses the results and proposes the next design iteration. Fabrication robustness, meta-atom libraries, supercells, metalenses and an independent FDTD check (MIT Meep) are part of the loop.

Development repository: https://codeberg.org/GiuseppeELio/metasurface-agent-pipeline. Changes between versions are listed in CHANGELOG.md.

Accompanying paper: arXiv:2611.08127.
